repositoryError.name: WorkerOutOfMemory
repositoryError.message: Exact whole-repository rule evaluation did not complete after isolated attempts at 4 GiB, 12 GiB, and 48 GiB V8 heap ceilings; D1 exhausted memory before producing a result, and D2-D5 were not attempted. This row is an explicit error and must not be counted as a zero or in analyzed-file denominators.
